This was my first visit to Arya Hospital, and no doubt Dr. Vidya Patil was very polite and approachable however the overall experience could be significantly improved through better patient privacy, staff training, clear communication, and time management.

Staff appeared inadequately trained, as my blood pressure was initially recorded incorrectly. Later during consultation only after I pointed it out was the diagnosis reconsidered and the incorrect BP reading influenced the whole check up. Which was not appropriate.
Additional sonography tests were conducted on the spot, but the purpose, findings, and implications were not explained clearly. I had to repeatedly ask probing questions to understand symptoms, and recommended precautions. But the response was not precise or satisfactory. Also it's a personal decision, such as choosing not to have children, which should be approached with sensitivity and professionalism. While healthcare professionals may see hundreds of patients, for each patient that consultation is a significant moment to seek clarity, understanding, and reassurance about their health.
